paragraphs.text: H.E. Edgmon is an author of queer speculative fiction across genres. He lives in the Pacific Northwest with a family of his design. He has written The Witch King duology, and Godly Heathens , book one in The Ouroboros duology. His next book, Merciless Saviors , was released on April 16, 2024, and his middle-grade debut The Flicker came out on September 24, 2024.
Edgmon contributed to the Magic Story for Outlaws of Thunder Junction .
